title: Orthogonal projection does not increase the pairing with a unit orientation (Hadamard bound)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let V, Q ⊆ ℝ^P (Euclid P) be linear subspaces, let q := V.starProjection be the orthogonal projection of ℝ^P onto V, let ξ ∈ Λ_m(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P m, a continuous linear functional on m-covectors) be a unit orientation of Q (IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q: there is an orthonormal family τ = (τ_1, …, τ_m) spanning Q such that ξ(β) = β(τ_1, …, τ_m) for every m-covector β, or ξ(β) = −β(τ_1, …, τ_m) for every m-covector β), and let α be an m-covector on ℝ^P. Write α∘q for the m-covector (v_1, …, v_m) ↦ α(qv_1, …, qv_m) (α.compContinuousLinearMap q). Then |ξ(α∘q)| ≤ |α|_E, where |α|_E = covectorEuclideanNorm α = (Σ_{i_1<⋯<i_m} α(e_{i_1}, …, e_{i_m})²)^{1/2} is the Euclidean coefficient norm.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (V Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ξ : MultiVector P m) (α : Covector (Euclid P) m), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → |ξ (α.compContinuousLinearMap V.starProjection)| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α
